data.text: Streamline KYC and AML checks for banks, fintechs, and lending platforms, accurately identifying individuals, PEPs, and sanctioned entities to prevent account fraud.
Verify customer identities to prevent duplicate accounts, combat payment fraud, and ensure the legitimacy of transactions across online retail and marketplace platforms.
Ensure accurate patient identification, prevent medical identity theft, and facilitate correct record linkage across disparate healthcare systems for improved patient safety.
Enhance citizen identity verification for public services, improve data accuracy in national records, and combat identity fraud within social welfare programs.
Accelerate and secure the onboarding process for new policyholders and loan applicants, reducing manual review and improving overall customer experience while mitigating risk.
Overcome complexities of transliteration and regional name variations in international transactions, ensuring consistent and accurate identity verification for global compliance.
